#!/bin/zsh
# T1 three-worker A/B — diagnostic runner.
#
# AUTHORING STATUS: design evidence for `T1-claude-3worker-ab-draft-packet.md`,
# authored under `T1-claude-3worker-ab-artifact-correction1-packet.md`. NEVER
# EXECUTED by the authoring seat. It becomes runnable only after two Sol xHigh
# reviewers approve this exact source AND V approves execution and records the
# final packet/artifact hashes in an external launch-authority file.
#
# WHAT THIS FILE IS
# The prior draft DESCRIBED signal handling, descendant tracking, the 512 MiB
# stop, unconditional restoration and the status override. A description cannot
# restore a governed test after a SIGINT. This file implements all of them, and
# the implementation is the point: every exit path — normal, failed, blocked,
# signalled — passes through `t1_finish`, which restores first, verifies custody
# second, and only then prints exactly one lawful marker.
#
# TWO ROOTS
# The outer Git root and the checkout root are different directories, and the
# prior draft conflated them: `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` from the outer
# repository does NOT land where `apps/`, `packages/`, `tests/` and `pnpm` live.
# Both are verified here, and every repository-relative command runs after an
# explicit `cd` to the checkout.
#
# USAGE
#   zsh run-claude-T1-3worker-ab-diagnostic.sh <launch-authority.json>
#
# EXIT STATUS
#   0   one lawful scientific marker was printed
#   2   one lawful `CODEX BLOCKED (...)` marker was printed
#   74  custody or restoration failure; overrides every other outcome

set -u
setopt pipefail
unsetopt err_exit          # every cell's raw status must be captured, not fatal
setopt no_unset

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Roots. Verified before anything else, because every later path depends on
#    getting these two right.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

T1_OUTER_ROOT="/Users/vladmihaimiron/Documents/DebateAIRO"
T1_CHECKOUT_ROOT="$T1_OUTER_ROOT/dialectical-engine"
T1_LOGS_REL="docs/missions/2026-08-17-accounts-privacy-security/logs"
T1_LOGS="$T1_CHECKOUT_ROOT/$T1_LOGS_REL"

if [[ ! -d "$T1_OUTER_ROOT/.git" ]]; then
  print -r -- "CODEX BLOCKED (custody)"
  exit 74
fi
if [[ ! -d "$T1_CHECKOUT_ROOT/apps" || ! -d "$T1_CHECKOUT_ROOT/tests" || ! -d "$T1_LOGS" ]]; then
  print -r -- "CODEX BLOCKED (custody)"
  exit 74
fi
cd "$T1_CHECKOUT_ROOT" || { print -r -- "CODEX BLOCKED (custody)"; exit 74 }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Frozen constants.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

T1_HEAD="9801f85d97e4263a7c8311304e29d6a03c4a6d15"
T1_NODE_VERSION="v22.23.1"
T1_INTEGRATION_FILE="tests/integration/registration-database.test.ts"
T1_ARCHITECTURE_FILE="tests/architecture/t1-argon2-worker-contract.test.ts"
T1_INTEGRATION_SHA="7f8a048afaa415f49f340fe2ef15aa2d4140af1bbf3916bddf5353797a295c58"
T1_ARCHITECTURE_SHA="3548b93282011be73310efe8a2eec31638133dc69a1d92a0cf4ffbc36f253ca1"

T1_TITLE_INTEGRATION="T1 N3 AB three-worker credential concurrency diagnostic"
T1_TITLE_RESOURCE="T1 N3 AB architecture resource cell"
T1_TITLE_POSITIVE_CONTROL="T1 N3 AB retained allocation positive control"
T1_TITLE_FAULT_UNCONFIRMED="T1 N3 AB fault unconfirmed death"
T1_TITLE_FAULT_LATE_EXIT="T1 N3 AB fault late exit before close"
T1_TITLE_FAULT_RETRY="T1 N3 AB fault close-time termination retry fulfilled"

# An ARRAY, expanded as "${T1_VITEST_FLAGS[@]}". A scalar relying on word
# splitting is exactly how a flag with an `=` in it silently becomes two
# arguments — or one argument containing a space — under zsh's default settings.
T1_VITEST_FLAGS=(
  --pool=forks
  --poolOptions.forks.singleFork=true
  --no-file-parallelism
  --reporter=verbose
)

# The twelve governed paths, in the exact order the frozen hash list uses.
T1_GOVERNED_PATHS=(
  apps/api/src/index.ts
  apps/api/src/main.ts
  apps/api/src/registration.ts
  packages/crypto/src/index.ts
  packages/crypto/src/argon2-worker.ts
  packages/crypto/src/argon2-worker-pool.ts
  packages/db/src/identity.ts
  packages/register/src/auth-policy.ts
  tests/integration/registration-database.test.ts
  tests/unit/registration.test.ts
  tests/unit/argon2-worker-pool.test.ts
  tests/architecture/t1-argon2-worker-contract.test.ts
)

T1_ARTIFACTS=(
  T1-3worker-ab-booted-rss-harness.mjs
  T1-3worker-ab-adjudicator.mjs
  T1-3worker-ab-command-matrix.md
  T1-3worker-ab-integration.patch
  T1-3worker-ab-architecture.patch
  T1-3worker-ab-mutation-helper.mjs
  T1-3worker-ab-manifest-builder.mjs
  run-claude-T1-3worker-ab-diagnostic.sh
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Mutable run state.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

T1_TMP=""
T1_BACKUPS_TAKEN=0
T1_PATCHES_INSTALLED=0
T1_TRACKED_PIDS=()
T1_TRACKED_PGIDS=()
T1_BLOCK_REASON=""
T1_MARKER=""
T1_FINISHED=0

t1_receipt() { print -r -- "$1" > "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-$2" }

t1_block() {
  # First reason wins. A later custody failure never overwrites the safety stop
  # that caused it, and a scientific marker can never overwrite a block.
  [[ -z "$T1_BLOCK_REASON" ]] && T1_BLOCK_REASON="$1"
  print -r -- "$1" >> "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-block-reasons.out"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Descendant tracking, termination and reaping.
#
# Each cell runs in its OWN process group, so the whole subtree — Vitest, its
# fork pool, embedded PostgreSQL, worker threads' host processes — can be
# signalled as a unit. The wrapper's own PID is never in that group, which is
# why the final custody check can ask "are exactly these PGIDs gone?" instead of
# a host-wide `pgrep -f T1-3worker-ab` that would match this script, the editor
# that has it open and any unrelated work on the machine.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

t1_track() {
  T1_TRACKED_PIDS+=("$1")
  local pgid
  pgid=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$1" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')
  [[ -n "$pgid" ]] && T1_TRACKED_PGIDS+=("$pgid")
}

t1_terminate_descendants() {
  local pgid
  for pgid in ${T1_TRACKED_PGIDS[@]}; do
    kill -TERM -"$pgid" 2>/dev/null
  done
  # A bounded grace period, then KILL. Sleeping is acceptable here precisely
  # because nothing else in this wrapper is running concurrently at this point.
  local waited=0
  while (( waited < 20 )); do
    local alive=0
    for pgid in ${T1_TRACKED_PGIDS[@]}; do
      kill -0 -"$pgid" 2>/dev/null && alive=1
    done
    (( alive == 0 )) && break
    sleep 0.5
    (( waited += 1 ))
  done
  for pgid in ${T1_TRACKED_PGIDS[@]}; do
    kill -KILL -"$pgid" 2>/dev/null
  done
  # Reap: the wrapper owns these jobs, so an unreaped zombie is the wrapper's.
  wait 2>/dev/null
}

t1_verify_descendants_gone() {
  local receipt="$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-final-descendants.out"
  : > "$receipt"
  local gone=0
  local pgid
  for pgid in ${T1_TRACKED_PGIDS[@]}; do
    if kill -0 -"$pgid" 2>/dev/null; then
      print -r -- "PGID=$pgid ALIVE" >> "$receipt"
    else
      print -r -- "PGID=$pgid GONE" >> "$receipt"
      (( gone += 1 ))
    fi
  done
  local pid
  for pid in ${T1_TRACKED_PIDS[@]}; do
    if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
      print -r -- "PID=$pid ALIVE" >> "$receipt"
    else
      print -r -- "PID=$pid GONE" >> "$receipt"
    fi
  done
  print -r -- "TRACKED_DESCENDANTS_GONE=$gone" >> "$receipt"
  grep -q "ALIVE" "$receipt" && return 1
  return 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Foreground cell execution.
#
# Foreground in the sense that matters: the wrapper waits for it and nothing
# else runs meanwhile. It is started with `setsid`-equivalent job control so it
# owns a process group, and its complete stdout, complete stderr and raw exit
# status land in three separate files.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

t1_run_cell() {
  local name="$1"; shift
  local out="$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-$name.out"
  local err="$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-$name.err"
  local sta="$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-$name.status"
  ( setopt monitor; exec "$@" ) > "$out" 2> "$err" &
  local pid=$!
  t1_track "$pid"
  wait "$pid"
  local status_code=$?
  print -r -- "$status_code" > "$sta"
  return $status_code
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Restoration and the final status override.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

t1_restore() {
  (( T1_BACKUPS_TAKEN == 1 )) || return 0
  local failed=0
  cp -p "$T1_TMP/registration-database.test.ts.bak" "$T1_INTEGRATION_FILE" || failed=1
  cp -p "$T1_TMP/t1-argon2-worker-contract.test.ts.bak" "$T1_ARCHITECTURE_FILE" || failed=1

  cmp "$T1_INTEGRATION_FILE" "$T1_TMP/registration-database.test.ts.bak"
  t1_receipt "$?" "restore-cmp-registration-database.status"
  grep -qx 0 "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-restore-cmp-registration-database.status" || failed=1
  cmp "$T1_ARCHITECTURE_FILE" "$T1_TMP/t1-argon2-worker-contract.test.ts.bak"
  t1_receipt "$?" "restore-cmp-t1-argon2-worker-contract.status"
  grep -qx 0 "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-restore-cmp-t1-argon2-worker-contract.status" || failed=1

  shasum -a 256 "$T1_INTEGRATION_FILE" \
    > "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-restore-hash-registration-database.out"
  shasum -a 256 "$T1_ARCHITECTURE_FILE" \
    > "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-restore-hash-t1-argon2-worker-contract.out"
  grep -q "$T1_INTEGRATION_SHA" \
    "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-restore-hash-registration-database.out" || failed=1
  grep -q "$T1_ARCHITECTURE_SHA" \
    "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-restore-hash-t1-argon2-worker-contract.out" || failed=1

  stat -f "%N size=%z mtime=%m" "$T1_INTEGRATION_FILE" \
    > "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-restore-stat-registration-database.out"
  stat -f "%N size=%z mtime=%m" "$T1_ARCHITECTURE_FILE" \
    > "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-restore-stat-t1-argon2-worker-contract.out"

  T1_PATCHES_INSTALLED=0
  return $failed
}

# One exit path for every outcome. Restoration first, custody second, marker
# last — and restoration failure overrides everything that came before it.
t1_finish() {
  (( T1_FINISHED == 1 )) && return
  T1_FINISHED=1
  local incoming="${1:-}"

  t1_terminate_descendants

  if ! t1_restore; then
    print -r -- "CODEX BLOCKED (restoration)"
    [[ -n "$T1_TMP" && -d "$T1_TMP" ]] && rm -rf "$T1_TMP"
    exit 74
  fi

  # Custody re-verification, after restoration and before any marker.
  git rev-parse HEAD > "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-final-head.out" 2>/dev/null
  grep -qx "$T1_HEAD" "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-final-head.out" || t1_block "custody"
  git diff --cached --name-only > "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-final-index.out" 2>/dev/null
  [[ -s "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-final-index.out" ]] && t1_block "custody"
  shasum -a 256 ${T1_GOVERNED_PATHS[@]} > "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-final-hashes.out" 2>/dev/null
  cmp -s "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-preflight-hashes.out" \
    "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-final-hashes.out" || t1_block "custody"
  git diff --check > "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-final-whitespace.out" 2>&1
  git status --porcelain > "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-final-worktree.out" 2>/dev/null
  t1_verify_descendants_gone || t1_block "custody"

  if [[ -n "$incoming" ]]; then t1_block "$incoming"; fi

  if [[ -n "$T1_BLOCK_REASON" ]]; then
    print -r -- "CODEX BLOCKED ($T1_BLOCK_REASON)"
    [[ -n "$T1_TMP" && -d "$T1_TMP" ]] && rm -rf "$T1_TMP"
    exit 2
  fi

  # Only a fully clean path may print a scientific marker, and only the one the
  # adjudicator computed.
  print -r -- "$T1_MARKER"
  [[ -n "$T1_TMP" && -d "$T1_TMP" ]] && rm -rf "$T1_TMP"
  exit 0
}

trap 't1_finish "custody"' INT TERM HUP QUIT
trap 't1_finish "custody"' EXIT

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. External launch authority. Absence or mismatch stops BEFORE any backup or
#    edit — the seat must never have touched a governed file on this path.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

fi
T1_PACKET_SHA=$(/usr/bin/sed -n 's/.*"packetSha256"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([0-9a-f]\{64\}\)".*/\1/p' \

  > "$T1_LOGS/T1-3worker-ab-preflight-packet.out" 2>/dev/null
